reason: The 256-iteration loop change is a narrow, low-risk test: the supplied history shows the current loops process one K step per iteration, and the proposed two-K body already exists. Panel packing tests a distinct 64 KiB layout and traversal, though repacking may erase any benefit. Prefetching is a smaller locality test with bounded addresses. Joint end-pointer checks follow an earlier unpromoted pointer-end experiment, so expected benefit is limited. Indexed loads may add address-generation cost; tile remapping and transpose fusion carry greater correctness and implementation risk. Tail handling and general-path transpose affect correctness or non-512 sizes, not the n=512 target. No proposal has measured evidence of a gain.
